messages.subject: RE: legent title
parts:
Hi Alfredo,


# something that works as you paste it helps ;)
# http://gist.github.com/270442

library(ggplot2)

tabella_grafico <- data.frame(
dia = rep(seq(from = 0, to = 10, length.out = 100), each = 2),
value = rnorm(100, mean = c(10, 30), sd = c(2, 5)),
variable = rep(c("a", "b"), 100)
)

cols <- c("blue", "green")

ggplot(tabella_grafico, aes(x=dia, y=value, group=variable)) +
geom_line(aes(linetype=variable, colour=variable)) +
scale_colour_manual(values = cols)

scale_colour_manual(name = "Custom Short Legend Name", values =
cols) +
scale_linetype(name = "Custom Short Legend Name")

the trick is to put the same name for the scales you want to display
together

Hope this helps,
fernando
